title: The Validity Gap in Health AI Evaluation: A Cross-Sectional Analysis of Benchmark Composition

bias_targets.methodology: Categorizing benchmark queries by age demographic (pediatric, adult, older adult) using a standardized taxonomy and an automated LLM coding instrument to identify the underrepresentation of pediatric and geriatric populations compared to a 'standard adult' default.

Analyzing the topic distribution of benchmark queries to compare the frequency of diseases prevalent in high-income Western regions (e.g., COVID-19) versus high-burden global pathogens common in low- and middle-income countries (e.g., malaria, tuberculosis).

Profiling 18,707 consumer health queries using a 16-field taxonomy to quantify the distribution of clinical intents, topics, and objective data types, revealing systemic neglect of chronic diseases and high-acuity behavioral health scenarios.
